ambiguous.why: 1204-1211 is a very fast camera pull-back with 2-frame holds (orb close-up -> Asta + woman -> Asta close). Asta's hair is already visible at 1206-1207 so 1208 looks continuous, but the framing jumps at 1208 and 1210 are large enough to be read as cuts

inside the long rotating sword shot 2148-2195: framing jumps abruptly (pommel goes from bottom to top of frame, crystals much larger) but same objects; probably a whip/rotation of the 3D camera, not a cut

4 impact frames (black frame with white cross 3463, inverted white frames 3464-3465, white/pink 3466) between 3462 and 3467, which show the same ice-devil shot with only slightly changed framing; flash inside a shot, possibly read as cut in + cut out
